title: Autopilot config.json
description: Strict JSON Schema for autopilot/config.json. Keys prefixed with _ are documentation comments and are always allowed. See docs/CONFIG_SCHEMA.md for field descriptions and annotated examples.

^_.description: Documentation comment — ignored by the engine.

provider.description: Active model provider id (e.g. 'claude'). Must match a lib/providers/ adapter.

profile.description: Workspace profile name under autopilot/profiles/. Controls backlog seed, task filters, and goal phases.

model.description: Default implementer model id (overridden per-cycle by implementerRouting logic).

architectModel.description: Model id used by the Architect stage when decomposing a macro-vision task.

minTasks.description: Minimum sub-tasks the Architect must produce.

maxTasks.description: Maximum sub-tasks the Architect may produce.

api_pools.description: Stage 1 key pool. Secrets live in env vars, never here.

key_env.description: Name of the env var holding the API secret.

retry_after.description: ISO date after which to retry, or null.

maxRetries.description: Key rotations per call before surfacing AllKeysExhaustedError.

defaultCooldownMs.description: Fallback cooldown when a 429 carries no retry-after hint.

providerMap.description: Maps adapter id to pool provider name (e.g. claude → anthropic).

models.description: Named model ids for each engine role. implementerLowest is optional.

implementerRouting.description: Risk-aware model routing for the implementer stage.

opusMinRisk.description: Minimum risk score that routes to the high-tier model.

opusKeywords.description: Task-title keywords that force the high-tier model regardless of risk.

scoring.description: Scoring weights and category bonuses for task prioritisation.

minProductShare.description: Minimum fraction of selected tasks that must be product-class.

minProductTasks.description: Minimum absolute count of product-class tasks in selection.

maxAttemptsBeforeBlock.description: Attempts before a task is blocked.

maxReviewFailAttempts.description: Allowed review failures before a task is escalated.

durationDays.description: Total planned project duration in days (controls scheduling horizons).

paths.description: Project-agnostic root paths. appRoot is relative to the repo root (autopilot/ parent).

appRoot.description: Repo root, relative to the autopilot/ parent directory.

queues.description: Engine queue/state directory targets, resolved relative to autopilot/.

cli.description: CLI wrapper configuration for invoking the model provider.

permission.description: Permission flag passed to the CLI (e.g. --dangerously-skip-permissions).

cycle.description: Per-cycle pacing and backlog top-up controls.

rateLimit.description: Exponential back-off bounds for rate-limit handling.

taskClasses.description: Task taxonomy that gates selection and review by product/engine/maintenance/migration class.

default.description: Class for tasks that cannot be classified from title/goal.

weeklyTokenQuota.description: Weekly token quota Q; null = derive from per-project cap or ∞.

safeMode.description: Engage tighter reserve/downgrade fractions when quota is unknown.

circuitBreaker.description: Engine safety halt — trips the STOP flag when consecutive failure thresholds are exceeded.

maxWindowCostUsd.description: Window spend ceiling in USD; null = disabled.

weeklyBudget.description: Weekly pacing governor — spreads cycle starts evenly to the reset date.

resetAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time of the next weekly window reset.

budgets.description: Per-project token budgets. Keys are projectId slugs (repo+goal); comment keys (^_) are ignored.

maxTokensPerCycle.description: Cumulative token cap for the current pacing window.

maxSpendPerEvent.description: Per-event USD ceiling (reserved for forward use).

validation.description: Project-specific validation commands (typecheck, build, lint, e2e). Lives in config, not engine code.

commands.description: Ordered list of validation commands. required:true commands block the cycle on failure.

lintRegressionGuard.description: Fail the cycle when the lint error count increases vs the baseline.

endpoint.description: HTTP endpoint to POST batched events; null = local buffer only.

integrationBranch.description: Branch all reviewed work lands on.

baseBranch.description: Branch the integration branch forks from.

repository.description: Optional path to the target repo (default '.' = the repo the kinetic lives in).

worktreeName.description: Optional git worktree name for isolated target-repo management.

providers.description: Provider-mapping system (U-42, core/providers.mjs). Defines the base set of model providers and maps agent roles to them. Omitting this block keeps the engine on the single global config.provider with no behavior change.

definitions.description: List of provider definitions. Each entry describes a named provider (anthropic/openrouter/custom) with its connection details.

name.description: Unique provider name referenced by roleMap.

type.description: Adapter type — defaults to name if omitted.

baseURL.description: HTTP endpoint base URL (required for openrouter/custom; ignored by claude).

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the API key. Secret never lives in config.json.

modelId.description: Explicit model ID for this provider, overriding tier-based resolution.

default.description: Mark this provider as the fallback when a role has no roleMap entry.

roleMap.description: Maps agent role names to provider definition names. Roles absent from this map use the global config.provider.

contextProvider.description: External codebase-context seam (core/context-provider.mjs). enabled:false = local analysis only.

context.description: Tag inserted into handoff filenames to isolate concurrent project contexts.

locks.description: Process-lock filenames (lib/lock-manager.mjs). {repoGoal} is expanded at runtime.

repoGoal.description: Optional override for the derived repo+goal segment.
